text:
sophie: Quick ask — design needed: a compact 'Inference Playbook' mini-visual pack for next week's webinar + inbound routing one-pager. Needs: hero tile, two benchmark microcards (cost vs latency), one-slide routing matrix, and a sticker-style checklist. Deadline: Tue EOD. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Inference-Playbook (please create a branch). Include alt-text notes and a contrast-safe palette. cc @ben @maria :eyes:
ben: Copy + messaging ownership? Also confirm exact export sizes and how many color variants we should make.
maria: I'll own copy. Will drop two hooks + microcopy in a bit. Variants: brand-blue primary + high-contrast dark reverse.
jake: Routing details: per-channel CTAs + sample UTM examples. Example: soops:utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=inference_playbook
sophie: Sizes: hero_web 1200x628, hero_social 1080x1080, slide 1920x1080, microcards 800x800, stickers 360x360. Deliver two message hooks for A/B.
maria: Hook A: "Serve smarter — cut inference unit cost by up to 2x."
maria: Hook B: "Predictable latency. Predictable cost. Redwood inference."
ben: Add a tiny explainer callout to distinguish Hosted / Dedicated / Private (one line each). Need a small SLA-tier badge for Dedicated.
sophie: Legal note — if we name community models include attribution. @legal-bot can you confirm required wording?
legal-bot: Include trademark line: "Redwood Inference and the Redwood logo are trademarks of Redwood Inference, Inc." If 3rd-party model names used, add: "Model names are trademarks of their respective owners." Send final exports for review.
designbot: Branch created: "playbook-mini-visuals/sophie-1759912345" and tags added #playbook #webinar #mini-tiles. First-pass frames uploaded.
ben: Export types: PNGs for social, SVG icons, and a copy-ready PPTX. Naming convention please. Also accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large display.
sophie: Export spec (use exact filenames):
- playbook_hero_web_v1.png (1200x628 PNG)
- playbook_hero_social_v1.png (1080x1080 PNG)
- playbook_slide_master_v1.pptx (1920x1080 slide)
- playbook_microcard_<variant>_v1.png (800x800 PNG) + SVG icons
- playbook_sticker_<n>_v1.png (360x360 PNG, transparent bg)
Include plain-text alt files, e.g., playbook_hero_web_v1_alt.txt with short alt description.
maria: Microcard copy ready — short bullets + CTA lines. Adding to Figma comments.
jake: Lead routing slide should list buckets: sales-lead, marketing-nurture, product-feedback; include example webhook payload fields and recommended SLA to respond to hot leads (1 business hour).
ben: Keep components modular (symbols) to speed localization. Provide color-variable styles. Also include keyboard-focus outline for interactive stickers.
sophie: Priority order: 1) hero web + social, 2) slide master + routing matrix, 3) microcards, 4) sticker checklist. Need first pass in 48 hours for webinar rehearsal.
designbot: First-pass frames uploaded to branch. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Inference-Playbook?node-id=branch-playbook-mini
ben: I'll review frames and leave comments. If anything is blocking I'll flag it here.
sophie: Thanks team — ping here with blockers. :rocket:
